description: Marketplace conformance (MKT-01): owner decision 1 as executable scenarios over the conformance driver, and the preset modes. Entries are today's failures against the kernel driver (today's kernel, with no marketplace); MKT-07, MKT-08, MKT-09 and MKT-14 remove theirs, and MKT-15b deletes the kernel driver with an empty list.

entries.reason: Today's kernel has no admin surface: the owner's install is refused as unsupported before the claim is reached. MKT-08's operations service installs (verify, put bytes, put row).

test: loads exactly the plugins pinned in the lock

failure.message: ^a plugin pinned in the lock runs
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: There is no jsails.plugins.lock: a locked deployment runs plugins.use only and has no way to pin a verified bundle.

test: fails the boot when a pinned plugin's bytes differ from the lock digest

failure.message: ^a lock digest mismatch must fail a locked boot
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: There is no lock and no digest check on stored bundle bytes, so nothing fails the boot.
